headline: US GDP COOLS 🍋💸 BUT CONSUMERS SPEND LIKE THERE'S NO TOMORROW 💳🔥
text: Uncle Sam 🦅🍔 saw his growth engine STALL at 1.5% 🚦📉 in Q2, down from 2.1% 🐢💔 – way below the crystal ball estimates 🔮😭! War with Iran 🌍🔥 and tariff tag 🏷️🤕 got the vibes icy ❄️, while Uncle Sam’s checkbook 📜💸 went on a diet. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh 🏦🧔 told the nation there’s NO MAGIC WAND 🪄🚫 to tame prices that keep partying above 2% for FIVE STRAIGHT YEARS 🎉📈! Oil prices BRUTALLY surged to $90 Brent 🛢️💥, making gas a $4/gal flex ⛽😭 at every pump. But hold up – consumers said YOLO 🛍️💃, splurging on light-duty trucks 🚚💨, furniture 🪑🍑, and prescription meds 💊🤑, pushing spending up to a juicy 3.2% 📈🍒! Fed says the economy still cruising on 'solid pace' 🛣️😎 despite Middle East drama 🌪️, and Capital Economics' Bradley Saunders 🧠📊 insists the numbers 'seriously undersell' a healthy beast 🐂💪. Translation: America’s still stacking those chips while the haters sweat 😤💦!
